narration.text: The interest federal agencies owe on late payments, claimed with the penalty. This is a chore for the office manager of a forty-person facility services contractor in Kansas City that bills three federal contracts. Athena works it across 4 portals: Invoicepoint, Contractdesk, Ledgerline bank and Mailnest. On the bench, she found 7 of 7 eligible items, worth 440 dollars and 16 cents of the 440 dollars and 16 cents there was to find. All 7 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 11 traps, and she walked past 11. Among them: A supplies invoice with 1,400 dollars held back in a quantity dispute. An invoice due on a Saturday and paid on the Monday. She took 5 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 3 hours, so she was about 39 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
